changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 450 تعريف قرض الاستهلاك: يلتزم المقترض برد نظير ما اقترضه عند نهاية القرض
changes.reason: [civil-code 450 ¶1] defines the loan for consumption and the duty to return the equivalent in kind, quantity and quality at the end of the loan.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 106 العقد شريعة المتعاقدين
changes.reason: [civil-code 106 ¶1] says the contract is the law of the parties; the formal-notice module already carries it as b36, imported rather than restated.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 107 يجب تنفيذ العقد طبقا لما اشتمل عليه وبحسن نية
changes.reason: [civil-code 107 ¶1] carries exactly this; paragraphs 2 and 3 (implied terms, unforeseen hardship) are not needed for the claim.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 323 على الدائن إثبات الالتزام وعلى المدين إثبات التخلص منه
changes.reason: [civil-code 323 ¶1] puts the proof of the obligation on the creditor and of release on the debtor; the periods module carries it as b42, imported.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 324 مكرر 5 ما ورد في العقد الرسمي (كالاعتراف بدين الموثق) حجة حتى يثبت تزويره
changes.reason: [civil-code 324 مكرر 5 ¶1] makes the content of an official deed proof until forgery is shown.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 333 في غير المواد التجارية لا يجوز الإثبات بالشهود فيما يزيد على 100.000 دج
changes.reason: [civil-code 333 ¶1] bars witnesses for a legal act above 100.000 dinars or of undetermined value outside commerce, unless a text says otherwise; [civil-code 333 ¶2] values it at the time of the act, accessories aside.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 454 القرض بين الأفراد يكون دائما بدون أجر: لا تطلب فوائد
changes.reason: [civil-code 454 ¶1] makes a loan between individuals always without return and voids any contrary clause; no interest request is proposed, and boundary n8 warns on an interest clause.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 179 لا يستحق التعويض إلا بعد إعذار المدين
changes.reason: [civil-code 179 ¶1] makes damages due only after notice unless a text says otherwise; the formal-notice module carries the statement and the prior step, imported.

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 186 تعويض الدائن عن الضرر اللاحق من تأخر المدين في الوفاء بمبلغ من النقود
changes.reason: [civil-code 186 ¶1] makes the debtor compensate the harm from late payment of a sum fixed when the claim is filed, between individuals; imported from the formal-notice module, with open point o1 on how it sits with [civil-code 454 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: civil-code 182 تقدير التعويض: ما لحق الدائن من خسارة وما فاته من كسب
changes.reason: [civil-code 182 ¶1] covers loss and lost profit as the natural result of non-performance or delay; [civil-code 182 ¶2] limits contractual damages to foreseeable harm absent fraud or gross fault.

changes.catalogueSays: إلزام المدعى عليه بأن يؤدي للمدعي مبلغ القرض المقدر بـ (...) دج
changes.reason: Rests on the duty to return at the end of the loan, [civil-code 450 ¶1], [civil-code 451 ¶1] and [civil-code 457 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: إلزام المدعى عليه بأن يؤدي للمدعي تعويضا عن التماطل قدره (...) دج
changes.reason: Rests on [civil-code 186 ¶1] and [civil-code 182 ¶1], after notice under [civil-code 179 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: تحميل المدعى عليه المصاريف القضائية
changes.reason: The catalogue gave no text; [cpca 419 ¶1] puts the costs on the losing party.

changes.catalogueSays: سند القرض أو الاعتراف بالدين
changes.reason: Proves the loan, needed in writing above the threshold of [civil-code 333 ¶1]; the order-to-pay document of the exits module is imported for the route of [cpca 306 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: محضر الإعذار
changes.reason: The notice is a condition of damages under [civil-code 179 ¶1], not of every loan claim; the module lists the notice and its service record only when a notice was served.

changes.catalogueSays: وصولات التحويل أو التسليم إن وجدت
changes.reason: Proves the handover the lender owes under [civil-code 451 ¶1] and that defines the loan in [civil-code 450 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: تاريخ القرض ومبلغه
changes.reason: The handover of a sum as a loan is the first element, [civil-code 450 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: أجل الرد المتفق عليه
changes.reason: The loan ends with the agreed term and repayment is due only then, [civil-code 457 ¶1] and [civil-code 451 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: المطالبة الودية أو الإعذار وتاريخه
changes.reason: An amicable demand is not a formal notice: [civil-code 180 ¶1] requires a warning or an act standing in its place; the module's steps and boundary n1 test the means and date.

changes.catalogueSays: امتناع المدعى عليه عن الرد
changes.reason: The plaintiff states the failure and the balance; the debtor proves any payment, [civil-code 323 ¶1].

changes.catalogueSays: لا يستحق التعويض إلا بعد إعذار المدين
changes.reason: [civil-code 179 ¶1]; the prior step is carried by the formal-notice module and imported.

[civil-code 336 ¶2] and [civil-code 336 ¶3]: obstacle to written proof, and lost title.

[civil-code 343 ¶1]: the decisive oath.

[cpca 323 ¶2]: provisional execution on an official deed or an acknowledged promise.
[cpca 323 ¶3]: provisional execution in urgency.

[civil-code 467 ¶1]: definition of lease, for boundary n3.
[civil-code 538 ¶1]: loan for use, for boundary n5.
[family-code 202 ¶1]: gift, for boundary n6.

Pay owed for work is not a loan, [civil-code 312 ¶3].
A loan for use returns the same thing, [civil-code 538 ¶1].
A gift has no duty to return, [family-code 202 ¶1].
Credit-institution or commercial loans follow other rules, [civil-code 456 ¶1] and [commercial-code 30 ¶7].

An order to pay already issued, its lapse and opposition periods, [cpca 308 ¶1] and [cpca 309 ¶2]; the commercial section and a refused order to pay.
Jurisdiction clauses, a defendant abroad, a judge as party, an estate claim and an unknown domicile, [cpca 37 ¶1] and [cpca 45 ¶1].

The mandatory elements of the petition, [cpca 15 ¶1], standing and interest, [cpca 13 ¶1], and language, [cpca 8 ¶1].
Conciliation and mediation offered by the judge, [cpca 4 ¶1] and [cpca 994 ¶1], and the prior conciliation before the specialised commercial court, [cpca 536 مكرر 4 ¶3].
